installedLicenseFilePresence.method: Check top-level LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING files in each installed package directory named by the SPDX inventory
installedLicenseFilePresence.limitation: Absence of a top-level file is not proof of unlicensed code; presence is not a file-level license audit

audit.limitation: A point-in-time npm advisory response, not a security guarantee or a substitute for maintained update ownership

openGates: file-level license and NOTICE review, including packages without a top-level license file
tarball-to-tagged-source comparison and upstream provenance/signature review
generated artifact and distribution dependency-boundary review
maintainer, legal, security and architecture admission decisions
